I build data pipelines and turn messy data into decisions people can act on.
Right now I am finishing my M.S. in Data Science at **Willamette University**,
where my capstone [analyzes library usage data of online resources](capstone.qmd) for
the Willamette Library.

I care about making data accessible and understandable to all, reproducible workflows, 
and explaining a model to the person who has to trust it. My special interests are sports, music and books.

**Currently employed by** [Photronics](https://www.photronics.com/) as a Process Engineer at the Boise, ID location. [Get in touch](about.qmd) or grab my [resume](resume.qmd).
